---
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nf-core/modules/master/modules/environment-schema.json
channels:
  - conda-forge
  - bioconda
dependencies:
  - bioconda::pretextgraph=0.0.9

// Copyright (c) the nf-core community under an open-source MIT license.
// See https://github.com/nf-core/modules for full license, file patching instructions and upstream contributing.

process PRETEXTGRAPH {
    tag "${meta.id}"
    label 'process_single'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${ workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container
        ? 'https://community-cr-prod.seqera.io/docker/registry/v2/blobs/sha256/28/28a9e6732fa1e04dd010a1596648055ec4b5bd300a16fd2f7b2c10e6594ad787/data'
        : 'community.wave.seqera.io/library/pretextgraph:0.0.9--c1c46eb0f0de5e85' }"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(pretext), path(bedgraph), val(graph_name)

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("*.pretext"), emit: pretext
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('PretextGraph'), eval('PretextGraph 2>&1 | sed "/Version/!d; s/.*Version //"'), emit: versions_pretextgraph, topic: versions

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args   = task.ext.args   ?: ''
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}_${graph_name}"
    if ("${prefix}.pretext" == "${pretext}") error "Input and output names are the same, set prefix in module configuration to disambiguate!"
    """
    zcat -f "${bedgraph}" | PretextGraph \\
        ${args} \\
        -i "${pretext}" \\
        -n "${graph_name}" \\
        -o "${prefix}.pretext"
    """

    stub:
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}_${graph_name}"
    if ("${prefix}.pretext" == "${pretext}") error "Input and output names are the same, set prefix in module configuration to disambiguate!"
    """
    touch "${prefix}.pretext"
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/pretextgraph"
description: "Converts bedgraph formatted data and embeds it as a graph track inside\
  \ a Pretext contact map"
keywords:
- "pretext"
- "bedgraph"
- "hic"
- "contact maps"
- "graph"
tools:
- pretextgraph:
    description: "Embeds bedgraph data into Pretext contact maps."
    homepage: "https://github.com/sanger-tol/PretextGraph"
    documentation: "https://github.com/sanger-tol/PretextGraph/blob/master/README.md"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/sanger-tol/PretextGraph"
    licence:
    - "MIT"
    identifier: ""
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'test', single_end:false\
        \ ]\n"
  - pretext:
      type: "file"
      description: "Pretext contact map to embed the graph into"
      pattern: "*.pretext"
      ontologies: []
  - bedgraph:
      type: "file"
      description: "Bedgraph formatted data (tab separated, may be gzip/bgzip compressed).\n\
        Sequence names must match those in the Pretext map.\n"
      pattern: "*.{bedgraph,bedgraph.gz,bedgraph.bgz,bg,bg.gz,bg.bgz,bed,bed.gz,bed.bgz}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3583"
  - graph_name:
      type: "string"
      description: "Name of the graph track. The name selects how values are accumulated:\n\
        PretextGraph matches it case-insensitively by substring against the known\n\
        types (not_weighted, gap, repeat_density, coverage, coverage_avg, telomere).\n\
        Any other name (e.g. \"GC\") falls back to telomere-style accumulation.\n"
output:
  pretext:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'test',\
          \ single_end:false ]\n"
    - '*.pretext':
        type: "file"
        description: "Pretext contact map with the embedded graph track"
        pattern: "*.pretext"
        ontologies: []
  versions_pretextgraph:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "Name of the process"
    - PretextGraph:
        type: "string"
        description: "Name of the tool"
    - PretextGraph 2>&1 | sed "/Version/!d; s/.*Version //":
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "Name of the process"
    - PretextGraph:
        type: "string"
        description: "Name of the tool"
    - PretextGraph 2>&1 | sed "/Version/!d; s/.*Version //":
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"

- "@villekytola-spb"
